note: Hand-written for smoke testing. Styled after CDVQA phrasing but NOT copied from any CDVQA question record, so no held-out image is coupled to a benchmark item. These are qualitative sanity checks and are NOT scored - they have no known-correct answers.

queries.text: Have the areas of buildings changed?
